name: run
args:
{"code":"const r = await bash({command: `python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, shutil
p=pathlib.Path('data/orders')
backup=pathlib.Path('/tmp/orders-backup-1794794964229')
shutil.copytree(p, backup, dirs_exist_ok=True)
count=0
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*.json')):
    text=f.read_text()
    data=json.loads(text)
    if data.get('status') != 'paid': continue
    qty=sum(item['qty'] for item in data['items'])
    if 'itemCount' in data:
        raise ValueError(f'{f} already has itemCount')
    pos=text.rfind('}')
    assert pos >= 0 and not text[pos+1:].strip()
    prefix=text[:pos].rstrip()
    f.write_text(prefix + ',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(qty) + '\n' + text[pos:])
    count+=1
print(f'Updated {count} paid orders')
PY`}); console.log(r.stdout, r.stderr);"}

name: run
args:
{"code":"const r = await bash({command: String.raw`python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('data/orders')
b=pathlib.Path('/tmp/orders-backup-1794794964229')
paid=other=0
for f in p.rglob('*.json'):
    before=(b/f.relative_to(p)).read_text()
    after=f.read_text()
    old=json.loads(before)
    new=json.loads(after)
    if old.get('status') == 'paid':
        assert new.pop('itemCount') == sum(i['qty'] for i in old['items']), f
        assert new == old, f
        assert after == json.dumps(json.loads(after), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', f
        paid+=1
    else:
        assert before == after, f
        other+=1
print(f'Verified {paid} paid orders and {other} unchanged orders')
PY`}); console.log(r.stdout, r.stderr);"}
